# kemp_intermediate_certificate (Resource)

Manages an intermediate (or CA) certificate on the LoadMaster. The LoadMaster sends intermediates along with server certificates to complete the chain, and also trusts them as CAs for client certificate authentication. They can't be replaced in place, so changing one deletes and re-adds it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Completes the chain served with certificates, and is trusted as a CA for
# client certificate authentication.
resource "kemp_intermediate_certificate" "issuer" {
  name        = "ZeroSSL_ECC_DV_CA_2"
  certificate = file("${path.module}/zerossl-ecc-dv-ca-2.crt")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certificate` (String) One certificate in PEM. Changing it forces a new intermediate.
- `name` (String) Name: letters, digits, underscores, hyphens and dots. Changing this forces a new intermediate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The rule name.
- `not_after` (String) When the certificate expires (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `subject` (String) The certificate's subject.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by name.
terraform import kemp_intermediate_certificate.example my_name
```
